job.title: Backend Engineer (Node.js & Microservices)
job.description: OmniDelivery (Bengaluru) powers hyper-local delivery across 15 Indian cities. We need a Backend Engineer for our order fulfillment team. The role focuses on Node.js/TypeScript, Apache Kafka event streams, Redis distributed locks, and clean architecture.

pool.text: Node.js & TypeScript: designed event-driven microservices with dependency injection and clean architecture
Apache Kafka: built producers, consumer groups, handled offset commits, and managed dead-letter queues
Redis Distributed Locks: implemented Redlock algorithm to avoid double-allocation race conditions
PostgreSQL: managed pessimistic row-locking (FOR UPDATE) for concurrent inventory reservations
OrderStream: event-driven order processing prototype demonstrating saga pattern rollbacks in Node.js
B.Tech Computer Science, PES University, Bengaluru, 2022–2026
Docker & Kubernetes: deployed multi-service compose stacks and wrote basic Kubernetes manifests
React Native: developed simple calculator mobile app
Backend Intern at SpeedyCart (Bengaluru, 6 months): maintained rider assignment notification pipeline
Prometheus & Grafana: instrumented HTTP request metrics and visualized 95th percentile latencies
UI Design: created social media carousels in Figma
Jest & Testcontainers: ran integration tests against ephemeral Kafka and Postgres containers in CI
